title: Oil Infused Greek Squash Loukoumades
description: A romantic Greek dish featuring squash and render fat, these loukoumades are a floral and aerated treat, perfect for a special occasion, and are whole30 friendly.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the almond flour, baking soda, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, honey, melted lard or duck fat, lemon zest, and orange blossom water.
Add the grated squash to the wet ingredients and stir until well combined.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and stir until a smooth batter forms.
Heat about 2-3 inches of lard or duck fat in a deep frying pan over medium heat until it reaches 375 degrees.
Using a spoon, drop the batter into the hot fat, making sure not to overcrowd the pan.
Fry the loukoumades for about 2-3 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and puffed up.
Remove the loukoumades from the fat with a slotted spoon and place them on a paper towel lined plate to drain excess fat.
Dust the loukoumades with confectioners sugar and serve immediately.
